FOCIL has been CFI'd for Heka.

### FOCIL for Heka/Bogotá

* FOCIL has been CFI'd for Heka and the headliner process for Heka will begin on January 8th. It will last for two months with the first half collecting headliner proposals and the second half deciding the headliners. Please see this [post](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/eip-8081-heka-bogota-network-upgrade-meta-thread/26876) for more information.

### Implementation Updates

* The [FOCIL execution spec](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/pull/1928) has rebased onto Amsterdam.
* **Lodestar** has rebased onto the latest commit of Fulu.
* **Erigon** has tried the interop with Reth using this [Kurtosis config](https://gist.github.com/faheelsattar/0ae716a53333b2afb4020c3f2dcf0d96).
* **[Pelle](https://x.com/PelleKrab)** is analyzing the public mempool to gain insight into transaction censorship.

### Next FOCIL Breakout Schedule

* As many people would be on vacation and ACD calls are cancelled for the next few weeks, the next FOCIL breakout call is planned for four weeks from now, on the 13th January, 2026.
